Reports the AutoSSL check task for the current cPanel user: 1 means in progress and 0 means not in progress.

Reports whether the system can automatically redirect account domains to SSL; this is a capability flag, not the current redirect configuration.
Available in cPanel 134 and later. The required domain is the fully qualified domain name to check.
The is_active flag means an AutoSSL provider is configured. The has_problems flag reports recorded DCV failures and defaults to 1 if the problems database is unreachable.
The will_renew flag is true only when an AutoSSL provider is active, that provider issued the current certificate, the domain is not excluded, and no DCV problems are recorded.
